eve: Kicking off mg_5011 (user_flags enum->jsonb) tonight at 01:30 UTC. Quiet window 00:30-02:30. Expect short exclusive locks on top 50 tenants. tagging @raj @ingrid for rollback/rollforward.

deploybot: scheduled migration mg_5011 by eve at 3487654321. Estimated rows: ~4.3M. Plan: online chunked apply (5k chunks), adaptive backoff, and spike-detect holdpoint. Commands: /deploybot abort mg_5011, /deploybot pin-version v1.6.0

raj: i'm on call 00:15-02:45. i'll monitor pg_lock_waits, lock_watch, and p99 for write paths. set alert if lock_wait_avg > 0.6s for >60s.

ingrid: rollback notes: snapshot available at 01:20 UTC. preferred rollback: graceful abort -> revert schema shim -> async backfill. backup steps in runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/mg_5011

eve: staging smoke succeeded with sample tenant (1.8M rows). replication lag stayed < 200ms. sample safe-alter used:
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN flags TYPE jsonb USING to_jsonb(flags::text);
COMMIT;
```

eve: backfill approach: chunked UPDATE with LIMIT and ORDER BY id to avoid long locks. if locks spike, we'll pause chunker and switch to background worker to emit work items to queue.

deploybot: canary routing: 8% traffic to v1.6.0-safe during window. automatic fallback to v1.5.9 if latency regresses >12%.

oncall: i'll be watching. ping @oncall with tenant id if you want me to escalate. i'll join the zoom on first alert.

raj: added temporary write rate cap for top-50 tenants and pinned migration row in tracker. also creating a short checklist in the ticket.

ingrid: holdpoint if we see sustained table-level lock >5s or if replica lag >1s across >3 replicas: -> pause chunker, run /deploybot abort mg_5011, flip routing to resilient variant, and schedule mg_5011-hotfix to switch to async workers.

eve: Post-deploy: collect slow query logs, lock wait histograms, and upload migration metrics to the migration dashboard. i'll post postmortem template link after close.

raj: noted. preflight in 15m. thanks team.
